home.title: Cosmereando — A reader’s guide to the Cosmere
home.description: A clear and welcoming starting point for exploring Brandon Sanderson’s Cosmere.

hero.eyebrow: A reader’s guide to the Cosmere
hero.heading: Begin your journey among the stars.
hero.intro: A calm, clear place to discover Brandon Sanderson’s shared universe, one story at a time.

cosmere.heading: What is the Cosmere?
cosmere.description: The Cosmere is a shared setting across many of Brandon Sanderson’s fantasy stories. Each saga has its own world, characters and rules, while the wider universe quietly gives them a common place in the stars.

worlds.title: Many worlds
worlds.text: Every planet offers a distinct atmosphere, history and way to experience fantasy.

doors.title: Different doors in
doors.text: Some stories begin with epic battles, others with mystery, discovery or political tension.

universe.title: One larger universe
universe.text: The books can be enjoyed on their own while still belonging to something much larger.

author.heading: Who created it?
author.text: Brandon Sanderson is an American fantasy author known for detailed worlds, inventive magic systems and ambitious long-form storytelling. The Cosmere is the setting that connects many of his fantasy novels and shorter works.

start.title: Start where you like
start.text: Standalone stories and different sagas make it possible to find an entry point that suits you.

curiosity.title: Follow your curiosity
curiosity.text: Explore new planets, cultures and systems of magic at your own pace.

discovering.title: Keep discovering
discovering.text: The catalogue is broad enough to offer a long reading journey without feeling like one single story.

routes.heading: Choose your route
routes.description: Find a reading order that matches the way you want to enter the Cosmere.
routes.communityText: Popular ways readers recommend exploring the universe.
routes.publicationText: Follow the Cosmere by the order in which its stories were published.
routes.journeyText: See the personal path that inspired Cosmereando.

library.heading: Books, sagas and planets
library.description: Explore the stories by the saga they belong to or the planet where they unfold.

books.title: Books
books.description: The complete catalogue of Cosmere works will be organised here by saga and standalone work.

routes.title: Reading Routes
routes.description: Community recommendations, publication order and the personal journey through the Cosmere will live here.

sagas.title: Sagas
sagas.description: Each Cosmere saga will have its own guided page with its works and related planet.

planets.title: Planets
planets.description: Planet pages will collect their related sagas, works, maps and magic systems.
